subject: design/init-hardening-v1
statement: All front-loaded predicates live in one new package (working name `internal/preflight`; the name is the implementer's), structured as a **check registry** — each check a row: id · applicability (a predicate over the resolved-or-prospective knobs) · probe (read-only) · outcome (`pass` | `refuse` with remedy and, where one exists, route | `advise` with warning). The registry is data the three consumers render identically (AP-10): init runs applicable checks and refuses on the first `refuse` class encountered (all outcomes reported, not just the first — a user fixes everything in one pass); preview runs the same registry and reports every outcome plus the would-do set (installer FR-24); doctor's prerequisite rows delegate to the same suite post-install (its report shape unchanged).
